title: 2024 Panini Prizm Blue Ice #75 Alex Rodriguez New York Yankees Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2024 Panini Prizm trading card featuring Alex Rodriguez, a former player for the New York Yankees, from the base set. The card is numbered 75 and is a Blue Ice parallel variety. It is not autographed and is part of the Major League (MLB) collection.
